title: Short Term Configuration for Mobitopp Runs.
description: Configuration for a mobitopp run using shared attributes

fractionOfPopulation.description: How much of the population is simulated

costMatrixConfigPath.description: Path to the cost matrix config.

durationMatrixConfigPath.description: Path to the duration matrix config.

resultPath.description: The directory, results are written to

resultName.description: The name of the simulation output csv

errorHandling.description: How errors during a simulation run should be treated.

simulationSeed.description: The seed randomization is based on.

dataFolder.description: The directory most simulation files like car.csv, person.csv... reside in. You can also set single paths to those files by setting for example the carCSV property.

modes.description: Which transport mode set is chosen. Possible values need to be registered in subprojects with a CodePlanSurrogateProviders

regionTypeCodes.description: Which region type codes are used. Possible values need to be registered in subprojects with a CodePlanSurrogateProviders

economicalStatusCodes.description: Which economical status codes are used. Possible values need to be registered in subprojects with a CodePlanSurrogateProviders
